periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval shape with a height-to-width ratio greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the inferior margin of the eye patch.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant wide separation on the cranial vertex relative to the head width.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the top of the ear pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast beige-brown discoloration of the ventral/belly fur relative to the white cranial fur.
